findings.detail: The source schedules show repeated issuers across March 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024 despite the extracted D06 continuity metric reporting only 19 of 160 issuers persisted.

rationale: D06 is an aggregate continuity flag. The raw filing does not support the 11.875% continuity metric: paired schedule rows show the same issuers and instruments persisting across March 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024, including 48Forty Solutions LLC and Accela Inc/US, and the schedule totals are nearly unchanged at $891,256,739 and $891,045,657 fair value. The low persistence metric is therefore a real extraction/issuer-normalization error rather than a source-level portfolio turnover event.
